archive_type: SEC filing excerpt transcription from official SEC-hosted HTML as rendered by web extraction; not raw filing HTML bytes. Filing URLs and exact displayed rows are retained; calculations below are reproducible from reported figures.

method.revenue_growth_yoy: (current comparable YTD revenue / prior-year comparable YTD revenue) - 1
method.free_cash_flow: net cash provided by operating activities - purchases/additions of property and equipment (MRVL line label: property, plant and equipment)
method.fcf_growth_yoy: (current comparable YTD FCF / prior-year comparable YTD FCF) - 1, only when both periods are positive; otherwise N/M
method.caveat: Issuer reporting calendars differ (AMD/INTC nine months; NVDA/MRVL six months), and ending dates differ. Results are same-length issuer-specific year-over-year windows, not synchronized calendar periods. FCF is a transparent derived proxy; it is not asserted to equal each issuer's non-GAAP free cash flow definition.
